label: RESISTANCE_CAUSING_NONBELIEF_1: The person’s resistance to God or relationship causally explains…
definition: The person’s resistance to God or relationship causally explains the absence of belief at this time. An unrelated fault, unobserved vice, not actively seeking, or disagreement about evidence is not definitionally such resistance. Resists is an interpreted causal predicate: its absence in real people is an open empirical claim.
note: Explicit interpretation vocabulary for #252. Source claims retain their own pinned locators; these records do not add axioms or establish the truth of the interpreted predicates.
